name: list_domains
description:
Retrieves a list of domains registered for the authenticated user or team. By default it returns the last 20 domains if no limit is provided.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} domains list. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to list from a request.

since.description: Get domains created after this JavaScript timestamp.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get domains created before this JavaScript timestamp.
